title: Direct Video Learning Engine — Audio + Vision Pipeline
description: Build a VideoLearningEngine that extracts knowledge directly from local video files (MP4/MKV/MOV) using FFmpeg for audio/frame extraction, Whisper API for speech-to-text, and Claude Vision for keyframe analysis. Integrates with existing knowledge extraction and component generation pipeline.

units.title: Verify/install FFmpeg, create VideoLearningEngine skeleton with extractAudio + extractKeyframes methods
steps: Check if ffmpeg is available on PATH, install if needed (winget install ffmpeg)
Create src/engines/VideoLearningEngine.ts with class structure
Implement extractAudio(videoPath): extracts audio track to WAV using ffmpeg child_process
Implement extractKeyframes(videoPath, opts): extracts frames using scene-change detection (-vf select=gt(scene,0.3)) or fixed interval
Add frame deduplication via perceptual hash to skip near-identical frames
Export from index.ts, register in engine registry
exit_conditions: ffmpeg accessible from Node.js child_process
extractAudio produces .wav file from test MP4
extractKeyframes produces PNG files with timestamps
TypeScript compiles clean

units.title: Implement Whisper API speech-to-text integration with timestamped transcript output
steps: Add transcribeAudio method using OpenAI Whisper API (or local whisper.cpp fallback)
Handle audio chunking for files >25MB (Whisper API limit)
Parse Whisper response into timestamped segments [{start, end, text}]
Add offline fallback: if no API key, attempt local whisper.cpp binary
Return TranscriptResult with full text + segments + language detection
exit_conditions: Whisper API call succeeds with test audio
Transcript has accurate timestamps
Files >25MB are chunked correctly
Graceful error if no API key and no local whisper

units.title: Implement Claude Vision keyframe analysis with batched frame processing
steps: Add analyzeKeyframes method that sends batches of 4-6 frames to Claude Vision
Craft manufacturing-specific vision prompts: extract parameter values, UI elements, toolpath patterns, machine movements
Parse vision responses into structured FrameAnalysis objects
Correlate frame timestamps with transcript segments for context enrichment
Handle rate limiting and cost tracking
exit_conditions: Vision API successfully analyzes test keyframes
Parameter values extracted from UI screenshots
Frame-transcript correlation produces merged timeline
Cost tracking reports per-video API spend

units.title: Build knowledge fusion pipeline: transcript + vision → structured knowledge items
steps: Create fuseKnowledge method that merges transcript segments with frame analysis
Group by topic/timestamp to produce unified KnowledgeItem objects
Apply domain classification (CAD/CAM/SHOP) using existing classify logic
Score confidence based on source (spoken + visible = high, spoken-only = medium, visual-only = medium)
Deduplicate against existing TribalKnowledgeEngine KNOWLEDGE_BASE
Output compatible with existing component generation pipeline (knowledge_bridge format)
exit_conditions: Knowledge items have provenance (video path + timestamp + frame reference)
Domain classification matches video content
No duplicate tips generated vs existing KNOWLEDGE_BASE
Output format matches knowledge_bridge.py specs

units.title: Create prism_video_learn dispatcher action + update /video-learn skill for local files
steps: Add video_learn_local action to appropriate dispatcher (or create videoLearnDispatcher)
Accept params: video_path (single file or directory), options (interval, max_frames, domain_override)
Wire to VideoLearningEngine.processVideo() orchestration method
Update /video-learn skill to accept local file paths alongside YouTube URLs
Add batch mode for processing directories of videos
exit_conditions: Dispatcher action callable via MCP tool
/video-learn C:/path/to/video.mp4 triggers local pipeline
Batch mode processes directory of MP4s
Results feed into component generation

units.title: Tests + process hyperMILL E-Learning videos as validation
steps: Write unit tests for VideoLearningEngine (mock ffmpeg, mock APIs)
Test extractAudio, extractKeyframes, transcribeAudio, analyzeKeyframes, fuseKnowledge
Integration test with a real hyperMILL E-Learning MP4 from HYPERMILL directory
Verify generated knowledge items are valid and useful
npm run build + npm test must pass
exit_conditions: All unit tests pass
At least 1 hyperMILL video successfully processed end-to-end
Generated tips are accurate and non-duplicate
Build passes, no test regression
